Claim it to lock it to you (this takes a deposit), then deliver the items from your inventory in as many batches as you like; they're used up. The last one pays the reward and returns the deposit. If the board is replaced first, or you abandon it, you're paid for what you delivered and the deposit is lost.

screen.dynamic_economy.exchange.mode.too: Switch between items, listings, listing your own items, your open orders and your collection box
screen.dynamic_economy.exchange.none_lis: Nothing in your inventory can be listed. Listings are for enchanted, damaged, renamed and other one-of-a-kind items; plain items go on the order book under Items
screen.dynamic_economy.exchange.listings: Enchanted, damaged, renamed and other one-of-a-kind items that players list at a price each. Click one to see it in full, set how many you want and buy it. What you buy goes to your collection box.
Click a listing to see it and buy it
More listings than fit; search to narrow them down
screen.dynamic_economy.exchange.buy_list: Pays %s now; the items go to your collection box
screen.dynamic_economy.exchange.list.too: Holds your items until they're bought; you get %s after the %s tax if all of them sell
screen.dynamic_economy.exchange.list.hel: List an item the order book can't take: enchanted, damaged, renamed or otherwise one of a kind. Pick it, set a price each and how many (up to one stack), and list it. Other players buy it at your price; you're paid into your bank less a %s tax. Listings count toward your open orders.

screen.dynamic_economy.exchange.help: Players trade here at their own prices. Pick an item (search finds any item), set a price and quantity, and post an order. Trades happen at the waiting order's price, best first. An order holds your items or money until it fills or you cancel it. Sellers pay a %s tax. Enchanted or damaged items: see Listings.
screen.dynamic_economy.exchange.buy.tool: Holds %s until it fills. Buys from the cheapest sellers at or below your price; anything you save comes straight back
screen.dynamic_economy.exchange.sell.too: Holds your items until they sell. Sells to the highest buyers at or above your price; you get %s after the %s tax
screen.dynamic_economy.exchange.open.too: Trade this item with other players on the Exchange
screen.dynamic_economy.exchange.orders.h: Click one of your orders or listings to see it. Cancelling returns what it still holds: a buy order's money goes back to your bank, the items of a sell order or listing to your collection box.
screen.dynamic_economy.exchange.orders.s: Click an order to see or cancel it

screen.dynamic_economy.exchange.cancel.i: Returns its %s unsold items to your collection box
